title: Tasked reward table
description: One file under config/tasked/quests/reward_tables/, named after the table's id: dice.json is the table a `tasked:random`, `tasked:loot`, `tasked:all_table` or `tasked:choice` reward points at with `"table": "dice"`. A roll of rewards: a weight-zero entry is always granted, every positive weight shares the rest of the probability space, and `lootSize` is how many times the dice are thrown.

$schema.description: Ignored by Tasked. For your editor, so it can autocomplete the rest of this file.

emptyWeight.description: The chance of nothing on a throw, against the positive weights. Only tasked:loot includes it: a tasked:random promises something.

lootSize.description: How many times the dice are thrown.

weight.description: How much of the table's weight this entry takes. Zero means always granted, which is how a table says "and everyone also gets this".

reward.description: The reward this entry grants. Every field a quest's own reward may carry, except `conditions`: an entry is handed out by the roll rather than claimed, so a gate on it would be validated and then ignored. Put conditions on the table reward itself.
